India's First Private Orbital Rocket Vikram-1 Successfully Launched

Skyroot Aerospace has successfully launched India's first privately developed orbital rocket, Vikram-1, from Sriharikota. The mission marks a significant milestone for India's private space sector, carrying multiple satellites and payloads into orbit. This achievement positions India as a key player in the global commercial space industry.
